entities.summary: "Two Hearts" is a song by Phil Collins from the soundtrack to the film Buster (1988) where it features in the end credits, in which Collins played the lead role of Buster Edwards. Released on 14 November 1988, "Two Hearts" topped the charts in the United States and Canada; in the former country, the song stayed at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 for two weeks and the Billboard Adult Contemporary chart for five weeks. It also reached number six on the UK Singles Chart.
